unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded comment on issue #1 (Gas low on agent-run accounts): the agent ability to pay is bounded by a gas balance it must keep topped up (research-bot-01 has 7 runs left). On Nano there is no gas - a send block costs nothing, the balance is entirely spendable, no runs-left table, no part-way failure. Offered an additive nano:mainnet exact scheme leaving Base Sepolia untouched.
